title: Systematic Detection of Energy Regressions in Software Version Histories
abstract: arXiv:2610.19895v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Context: Green software engineering is emerging as a crucial response to the rising energy impact of information technology, especially in continuous development. However, challenges remain in devising automated methods to efficiently identify energy regressions across commits. In particular, little effort has been put into automatically detecting regressions at the commit level by identifying statistically significant changes in energy consumption. Objectives: This paper presents EnergyTrackr, an approach for detecting energy regressions across multiple commits. Methods: We empirically evaluated EnergyTrackr on 1,932 commits from five Java projects, assessing its ability to identify significant energy changes. We also compared a straightforward linear algorithm that analyzes the entire commit history with a more efficient dichotomous search algorithm. translated_title: 软件版本历史中能耗退化的系统性检测
translated_abstract: 背景：绿色软件工程正在成为应对信息技术日益增长的能耗影响的重要举措，尤其是在持续开发过程中。然而，如何设计自动化方法以高效识别跨提交的能耗退化仍然存在挑战。特别是，在通过识别能耗的统计显著性变化来自动检测提交级别退化方面，目前的研究努力甚少。目标：本文提出了EnergyTrackr，一种用于检测跨多个提交的能耗退化的方法。方法：我们在来自五个Java项目的1,932个提交上对EnergyTrackr进行了实证评估，评估其识别显著能耗变化的能力。我们还将一种分析整个提交历史的简单线性算法与更高效的二分搜索算法进行了比较。结果：评估结果表明了EnergyTrackr在识别能耗退化方面的有效性。
tldr: 本文提出EnergyTrackr方法，通过识别提交间能耗的统计显著性变化来自动检测软件版本历史中的能耗退化，并在五个Java项目的1,932个提交上验证了其有效性，同时比较了线性算法与二分搜索算法的效率。
